create TABLE if not exists AuthToken(Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, token TEXT NOT NULL, tokenName TEXT NOT NULL, permission TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'read-write', expireType TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'date', expireDate TEXT, createdAt TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE if not exists AlbumConfig(_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,         MetaLocalVersion INTEGER, FolderLocalVersion INTEGER, DbCurVersion INTEGER, OpenId TEXT,         extData1 TEXT, extData2 TEXT, extData3 TEXT, extData4 TEXT, extData5 TEXT, serverTime INTEGER, cleanCycle INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE if not exists AlbumFront(_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, metaId TEXT UNIQUE, fileName TEXT, clientPathAlias TEXT, mediaFormat TEXT, mediaType INTEGER, groupId TEXT, groupType INTEGER, modifiedTime LONG, duration LONG, width INTEGER, height INTEGER, indexInGroup INTEGER, md5 TEXT, createTime TEXT, dimension TEXT, clientCreateTime LONG, totalSize LONG, orientation INTEGER, version	LONG, extAttrMap TEXT, longitude DOUBLE, latitude DOUBLE, geoHash TEXT, folderId TEXT, clientPathMode INTEGER, clientBucketId INTEGER, status INTEGER, original_data TEXT, thumb_data TEXT, original_media TEXT, save_dir TEXT, clientSource INTEGER, label_type INTEGER, label_name TEXT, user_action INTEGER, user_sync INTEGER, user_status INTEGER, extData1 TEXT, extData2 TEXT, extData3 TEXT, extData4 TEXT, extData5 TEXT, address TEXT);

CREATE TABLE if not exists AlbumLocal(_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, front_id LONG UNIQUE, image_id INTEGER, bucket_id TEXT, md5 TEXT, uniform_key TEXT, date_uploaded LONG, date_used LONG, is_slimmed INTEGER, camera_refocus INTEGER, live_photo TEXT, is_live_photo INTEGER, in_recyclebin INTEGER, recycle_id INTEGER, schedule_task INTEGER, updated_task INTEGER, original_task INTEGER, clientCreateTime LONG, md5_version TEXT, data_url TEXT, need_as_part INTEGER, part_size LONG, pre_upload_result TEXT, pre_download_result TEXT, data2 TEXT, damaged INTEGER, data4 TEXT, renew_times	INTEGER, extData1 TEXT, extData2 TEXT, extData3 TEXT, extData4 TEXT, extData5 TEXT);

CREATE TABLE if not exists AlbumFolder(_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, folderId TEXT, folderName TEXT, clientPath TEXT, status INTEGER, createTime INTEGER, modifiedTime INTEGER, clientPathMode INTEGER, clientBucketId INTEGER, version INTEGER, clientBucketDisplayName TEXT, userStatus INTEGER, extData1 TEXT, extData2 TEXT, extData3 TEXT, extData4 TEXT, extData5 TEXT);
CREATE TABLE if not exists AlbumTempFolder(_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, folderId TEXT UNIQUE)
CREATE TABLE if not exists AlbumTempMeta(_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, metaId TEXT UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE Sync(_id integer primary key not null, cloudVersion integer, guid integer, lastUpdate integer, dataClass integer, status integer, localId text not null, localVersion text, contentHash text, moduleData text, localStatus integer, tableList text, tableId text, legacy integer, extData1 text, extData2 text, extData3 text, extData4 text, extData5 text);
create index idx_guid on Sync(guid);

CREATE TABLE Events(_id integer not null primary key AUTOINCREMENT, calendar_id integer, isModified integer, deleted integer, title text, createTime text, modifyTime text, dtStart integer, dtEnd integer, originalDtStart integer, originalDtEnd integer, lunarEvent integer, BirthdayState integer, birthLeapMonth integer, birthFebAddDays integer, BirthdayAlertState integer, isShowLunar integer, timezone text, allDay integer, hasAlarm integer, description text, rule text, duration text, reminderList text, reminderAlertType integer, eventStatus integer, originalInstanceTime integer, originalSyncId text, dirty integer,location text, locationDetail text, eventTimezone text, accessLevel integer, hasExtendedProperties integer, synced  integer, noteGuid text, noteType text, extendedProperties text);
CREATE TABLE Colors(_id integer primary key not null, color_index text, color integer, color_type integer, account_type text, account_name text);

CREATE TABLE Calendar(_id integer not null primary key AUTOINCREMENT, _sync_id text, isModified integer, sync_events integer, deleted text, accountName text, accountType text, name text, displayName text, mutators text, calendar_access_level integer, calendar_location, calendar_timezone text, ownerAccount text, isPrimary integer, maxReminders integer, visible integer, colorIndex text, color integer, cal_sync10 text);
CREATE TABLE Instances (_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id INTEGER, begin INTEGER, end INTEGER, startDay INTEGER, endDay INTEGER, startMinute INTEGER, endMinute INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE ExtendedProperties(_id integer primary key not null, event_id integer, name text, value text);
CREATE TABLE Reminders(_id integer primary key not null, event_id integer, minutes integer, method integer);
CREATE TABLE Config (id integer NOT NULL, openId text, DbCurVer integer, Timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ex1 text, ex2 text, ex3 text, ex4 text, ex5 text, ex6 text, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE caldavAccount (_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, source TEXT, account TEXT, authorization TEXT, refresh_token TEXT, syncURL TEXT, frequency TEXT, lastSyncTime TEXT, status INTEGER DEFAULT 0, syncToken TEXT DEFAULT '', UNIQUE(account, source));

CREATE TABLE caldavCalendar (_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account_id INTEGER, accountDisplayName TEXT, accountURL TEXT, ctag TEXT, color INTEGER, syncToken TEXT DEFAULT '', synced INTEGER DEFAULT 0, localId TEXT DEFAULT '', source TEXT DEFAULT '', canEdit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, visible INTEGER DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE(accountURL));

CREATE TABLE caldavEvent (_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, accountURL TEXT, eventURL TEXT, etag TEXT, content TEXT, synced INTEGER DEFAULT 0, localId TEXT DEFAULT '', active INTEGER DEFAULT 1, reminder_lastupdate INTEGER DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE(eventURL));

CREATE TABLE caldavReminder (_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id INTEGER, subid TEXT, title TEXT, description TEXT, isdate INTEGER, dtstart INTEGER, trigger_type INTEGER, trigger_time INTEGER, duration INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE caldavInstances (_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, event_id INTEGER, begin INTEGER, end INTEGER, startDay INTEGER, endDay INTEGER, startMinute INTEGER, endMinute INTEGER);

create trigger if not exists delete_caldavAccount BEFORE DELETE ON caldavAccount BEGIN DELETE FROM caldavEvent WHERE caldavEvent.accountURL in (SELECT caldavCalendar.accountURL FROM caldavCalendar WHERE caldavCalendar.account_id = OLD._id); DELETE FROM caldavCalendar WHERE caldavCalendar.account_id = OLD._id; END;

create trigger if not exists insert_caldavCalendar BEFORE INSERT ON caldavCalendar FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM caldavAccount WHERE _id = NEW.account_id) THEN NULL ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'account_id not found in caldavAccount table') END; END;
create trigger if not exists delete_caldavEvent BEFORE DELETE ON caldavEvent BEGIN DELETE FROM caldavReminder WHERE caldavReminder.event_id = OLD._id; END;

create trigger if not exists insert_caldavReminder BEFORE INSERT ON caldavReminder FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM caldavEvent WHERE _id = NEW.event_id) THEN NULL ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'event_id not found in caldavEvent table') END; END;
